I'm looking for a telescopic travel rod to fit into my travel/BOB bag. I've seen some on Amazon that I'm thinking about but was wondering if y'all have had hands on experience and have recommendations before I buy anything
Hello v/Fishing, I'd like some help picking out a new rod.

I've never found a telescopic pole that I liked. The longest I've owned one was 6 weeks before the damn thing broke.

That's their biggest issue, they're made for transport and quality takes a back burner. I've had them snap on me, get jammed either extended or contracted. I've had the eyes break off during transport. All around I just haven't found a single one that was worth it.

However, I did pick this up over two years ago and I still use it. The spring allows it to have the tension of a full length rod without the size. I've reeled in 3 lb bass on it and it's done the job admirably.

My biggest issues are the lack of casting range and the price tag. But I'd still recommend it over a telescoping rod any day.

You can get them here http://www.emmrod.com/
